message.content:
The cover of "TEMPO" magazine features several gray and white columns. Most stand tall, but some are broken into segments or crumbled. In the upper left, a small figure of a man in a white long-sleeved shirt and black pants stands atop a broken column, raising one hand. In the lower right, another man in a red and black robe holds a gavel while reaching his other hand upward. The background is a mix of dark gray and light gray tones.

At the top, large red text reads "TEMPO" above the smaller slogan "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Other headlines include "Smokel Emas Si Manusia Banyak Harta H.64" and "Tergesa-gesa Kereta Cepat Jakarta-Surabaya H.74". White text in the lower left says "UGAL-UGALAN PAMAN GIBRAN" followed by several lines of smaller text mentioning "Keluarga Presiden Jokowi," "Mahkamah Konstitusi," "Gibran Rakabuming Raka," and "calon wakil presiden." A barcode and QR code are in the top right corner along with the date "13-19 NOVEMBER 2023" and price "RP 50.000".
